verdict.rationale: Asynchronous batch jobs are a fair question for an LLM API, but the evidence pack never mentions a batch endpoint or a batch discount. The nearby features are context caching, enabled by default, and free capacity-expansion requests for higher concurrency. Both are different capabilities, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can submit asynchronous batch jobs at a documented discount versus real-time pricing
